title: Freemax Maxus 200W Box Mod Kit with Maxus Pro/ M Pro 2 Tank
description:
Freemax Maxus 200W Box Mod Kit with Maxus Pro/ M Pro 2 Tank
The Freemax Maxus 200w Box MOD Kit uses a simple battery loading mechanism that works on both single and dual batteries. SmartLoad Technology also guarantees a secure vape. You have complete control of how the batteries are charged. The Freemax Maxus Box MOD has a variety of performance modes to choose from.
The
FreeMax
M Pro 2/ Maxus Pro Tank is designed with a combination of resin and metal, together with stylish Honeycomb glass, which makes it so unique among all the other tanks. It also has three distinctive steel balls mechanisms for a more stable vaping experience, and to avoid potential leaking. Equipped with military-grade SS904L mesh and Tea Fiber Cotton formula, the FreeMax M Pro 2, Maxus Pro Tank can provide you the best vaping experience.
